searchText: In the current proposal, `forkchoiceUpdated` is sent to relays and relays propagates it further to builders, right? Can an adversarial node send a different fork choice state and make builders to build a payload on top of block `A'` while proposer's tip is block `A` and make builders useless for a slot as validator won't accept payload built on top `A'` in this case? correct, this is why forkChoiceUpdated must either be removed or authenticated
